item.title: Penn State Extension Offers Webinar on Food Safety for Volunteers
item.description: “Cooking for Crowds: A Volunteer’s Guide to Safe Food Handling” will address food safety issues faced by volunteer-based organizations.

item.title: Florida Releases Candy Testing Results Under Healthy Florida First Initiative
item.description: The Florida Department of Health tested 46 candy products from 10 companies for heavy metals and detected arsenic in 28 of them.

item.title: FoodChain ID Acquires Sbcert
item.description: Sbcert is known for its certifications related to product and livestock traceability, known as SISBOV.

item.title: USDA Offers Tips to Keep Food Safety in Play this Super Bowl
item.description: Many Super Bowl favorites, including pizza, chicken wings, hamburger sliders and chili, should not be left out at room temperature for more than two hours — what USDA calls the Danger Zone.

item.title: Mettler-Toledo Launches New Product Inspection eGuide for Meat, Poultry and Seafood
item.description: The eGuide explores challenges specific to meat, poultry and seafood production and outlines quality control functions, including foreign body detection, label verification and more.

item.title: PTNPA 'Nut Numbers' Report Reveals Economic Impact
item.description: The Peanut and Tree Nut Processors Association released its first economic impact report, which highlights the influence of the nut industry.

item.title: FSIS Extends Comment Period on Strategies to Reduce Salmonella in Poultry Products
item.description: The comment period will now end March 4.

item.title: FoodChain ID and CE-LAB Partner on Certification and Verification Project in Ukraine
item.description: The partnership aims to certify that reclaimed land and water damaged by war and restored through phytoremediation, crater recultivation and field diagnostics are again suitable for agricultural use.

item.title: PaperTech Acquires Bake-Best Trays, Expanding Packaging Platform
item.description: Bake-Best’s pressed paperboard tray products are designed for ovenable application, enhancing PaperTech's tray portfolio with additional formats and microwave active susceptor solutions to improve the browning and crisping of food contents.

item.title: FDA, Alliance to Stop Foodborne Illness to Co-Host Food Safety Culture Webinar Feb. 18
item.description: The webinar, featuring Sean Leighton, global vice president of food safety, quality and regulatory at Cargill, and Sarah Nayani, director of compliance at Arctic Storm Management, will discuss how to avoid complacency through proactive, ongoing reinforcement of organizational values.
